# maple_dashboard (Resource)

A Maple dashboard. Widget, section and variable documents use the v2 wire shape: build the dashboard in the UI and copy them from `GET /v2/dashboards/{id}`, or import it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "maple_dashboard" "checkout" {
  name        = "Checkout"
  description = "Golden signals for the checkout flow"
  tags        = ["checkout"]
  time_range  = jsonencode({ type = "relative", value = "12h" })

  # Widget documents in the v2 wire shape. Build the dashboard in Maple once,
  # then copy them from `terraform import` or GET /v2/dashboards/{id}.
  widgets = jsonencode([
    {
      id            = "error-rate"
      visualization = "chart"
      data_source   = { kind = "route", endpoint = "traces_timeseries" }
      display       = { title = "Error rate" }
      layout        = { x = 0, y = 0, w = 6, h = 4 }
    },
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Dashboard name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Shown under the dashboard name.
- `refresh_interval_seconds` (Number) Auto-refresh interval: one of 0, 5, 10, 30, 60, 300 or 900. Unset means no auto-refresh.
- `sections` (String) List of collapsible widget groups. Widgets join one with `section_id` and `tab_id`; their `layout` is relative to the section's grid. Write it with `jsonencode(...)`.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags for filtering the dashboard list.
- `time_range` (String) Default time range, e.g. `{ type = "relative", value = "12h" }` or `{ type = "absolute", start_time = "…", end_time = "…" }`. Defaults to the API's default when unset. Write it with `jsonencode(...)`.
- `variables` (String) List of dashboard variables. Write it with `jsonencode(...)`.
- `widgets` (String) List of widget documents. Write it with `jsonencode(...)`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The `dash_…` public ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import maple_dashboard.example <id>
```
